_readme: Which shipped registers the repository keeps. Content is data (rule: corpora, match tables and rules live
in JSON); the mechanic is pbr_retention.py and the driver calls it in the ship leg.
keep_newest is per family: the newest shipped version and its immediate predecessor, so a build can always be
diffed against the register it was built from. That is what verifies a build did what its change log claims.
A register below that line is superseded UNLESS it is pinned here or still named literally by a toolkit script,
which pbr_retention.py scans for and will not prune over.
NOTE ON REPOSITORY SIZE: this setting governs the WORKING TREE only. A register already committed stays in git
history at its full size forever, because xlsx is a zip git cannot delta-compress. Retention caps what a fresh
clone checks out; it does not cap what a fresh clone downloads.

pinned.why: Inheritance source for EVERY branch build (pbr_stage.V127). Read on every run and its md5 is stamped into the shipped workbook, so it is a build input, not a superseded output, despite sorting below v128 and v129.
